title: Motorola Is Back in Force: A Premium Phone for $1,600 with a 200MP Camera! 📸
body: Motorola Is Back in Force: A Premium Phone for $1,600 with a 200MP Camera! 📸
Motorola announced its most powerful phone yet, the Signature 27, a premium phone that rivals the big names at $1,599.99.
The phone comes with a 200-megapixel main camera with an optical zoom lens that reaches up to 3x, so you can photograph distant objects clearly without getting close.
Its screen is 'tandem OLED' — two glowing layers on top of each other to make it brighter and stronger — and its huge 7000mAh battery lasts a full day and more.
And the exciting part: Motorola promised 7 years of system updates, and it supports GrapheneOS, which focuses on privacy. Pre-orders in the US open November 19, and sales begin November 26.
Would you pay $1,600 for a 200-megapixel camera and a 7000mAh battery? 💰
